facts.name: Lamb's Ear
facts.notes: Velvety silver leaves that kids love to touch, making a bright mat at the front of a sunny bed. Cut off the flower stalks to keep it neat.

sources.title: English Gardens: Lamb's Ears
sources.note: Sold at English Gardens (also at Wiegand's).

companions.why: Combines with yellow flowers such as coreopsis and goldenrod, pink ones such as purple coneflower, prairie grasses and silver plants such as Stachys (lamb's ear).

sources.title: Wisconsin Horticulture (UW–Madison Extension): Blazing Star article
